# TemporalErrorFeedback

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A feedback loop in sigma-delta conversion that carries quantization error from previous timesteps into the current spike decision. Reduces accumulated conversion error over time, making deep SNN inference stable and accurate on neuromorphic substrates.
